title: Limited Prioritization of Eco-Friendly Transportation Modes at Traffic Signals
situation: Limited Prioritization of Eco-Friendly Transportation Modes at Traffic Signals
entities: 1. Traffic signal systems controlling intersections. 2. Eco-friendly transportation modes, such as electric vehicles (EVs) and bicycles. 3. Motorists, cyclists, and pedestrians using eco-friendly transportation modes.
communication_type: Traffic Signal-to-Vehicle and Traffic Signal-to-Pedestrian Communication
description: Traffic signals may not adequately prioritize eco-friendly transportation modes, such as electric vehicles or bicycles, which can discourage their use and limit their potential to reduce carbon emissions and promote sustainable transportation options.
